packageRules.description: Python non-major updates as one PR per run, not one per package
JS dev tooling as one PR per run
JS runtime deps as one PR per run
CI actions are exercised by every pipeline run
CI images (cimg/*) live in .circleci/, which maps to the full gate: migrations + compose network run on the PR
Majors automerge too: a major bump to a manifest triggers migrations + compose network (see .circleci/scope-mapping.txt), so green means the suite proved it
Exception: GitHub Actions are deactivated for pull requests (ci_pr.yaml is workflow_dispatch only), so nothing a PR runs can prove a change to these files

Database patches belong to watchtower, not Renovate (db-tier plan, D1/D15): a database tag names the MINOR and floats the patch (mariadb:13.0), so Renovate must never rewrite it to a concrete 13.0.x - that would fence the server off from every later fix. Patches arrive through the watchtower `db` scope in the daily 06:00 window. Placed LAST on purpose: later packageRules win, and the repo's global 'majors automerge' rule above would otherwise re-enable them.

Database minor/major bumps are a reviewed step (D1/D15): never automerged (this overrides the global 'majors automerge' rule above), gated behind the dependency dashboard, grouped so one approval is one reviewed change. A 13.x -> 14.x move also needs the datadir/backup evidence the db-tier plan asks for.
